crossRefs.note: My heart was hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned. I spoke with my tongue:
Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in Yahweh.
Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart; so does earnest counsel from a man’s friend.
Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.
The Lord Yahweh has given me the tongue of those who are taught, that I may know how to sustain with words him who is…
Your words were found, and I ate them. Your words were to me a joy and the rejoicing of my heart, for I am called by…
If I say, I will not make mention of him, or speak any more in his name, then there is in my heart as it were a burning…
“Isn’t my word like fire?” says Yahweh; “and like a hammer that breaks the rock in pieces?
It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.
For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul…
Then he opened their minds, that they might understand the Scriptures.
Paul, as was his custom, went in to them, and for three Sabbath days reasoned with them from the Scriptures,
explaining and demonstrating that the Christ had to suffer and rise again from the dead, and saying, “This Jesus, whom…
When they had appointed him a day, many people came to him at his lodging. He explained to them, testifying about God’s…

translations.web: They said to one another, “Weren’t our hearts burning within us, while he spoke to us along the way, and while he opened the Scriptures to us?”
translations.bsb: They asked each other, “Were not our hearts burning within us as He spoke with us on the road and opened the Scriptures to us?”
translations.kjv: And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?
translations.asv: And they said one to another, Was not our heart burning within us, while he spake to us in the way, while he opened to us the scriptures?
